markets.rules_primary: If Rome Odunze records the most receiving yards across all Pro Football games in Week 8, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
If Rome Odunze does not participate in the week the market will resolve to No. If multiple players tie for the most yards, the markets will resolve to 1/N, where N is the number of players tied for the highest value. No holders will receive $1 minus the Yes payout.
